text:
harper: FYI planned staging wave 01:15 UTC touching API header-split + router parse-buffer tweak + console routing rule. proposing "traffic-shim" approach: pin runtime for window, hold the deploy, prewarm shard-2, then gradual ramp.
diego: +1. previous run had router backpressure and a small KV eviction burst on shard-2 when header payloads hit ~4kb.
diego: snippet: `[staging-router] WARN backpressure id=shard-2 reason=header_parse_slow`
anu: recommend pinning runtime v2.17.0 for staging (contains parse-buffer guard) and keep console split FF off for the window. add transient alerts for `router.backpressure_rate` and `kv_eviction_rate`.
olivia: rollback criteria I'd use: sustained user-facing 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR kv_eviction_rate >0.02 for 5m OR session.reset_rate >2x baseline. also abort if canary p95 >550ms for 10m.
harper: agree. propose warmup timeline: start prewarm 22m before cutover, then traffic 25% -> 65% -> 100% over 12m. hold until 15m stable.
diego: i'll add a short-lived grafana dashboard and an alert rule: `sum(rate(kv_eviction[5m])) / sum(rate(requests[5m])) > 0.01` -> fire. link posted when ready.
harper: deploy commands i'll execute once we agree:
```
/deploy hold staging --reason "traffic-shim-header-safety" --by harper --until 2961238000
/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-2 --type cache --by harper
```
deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2025-02-12T01:15Z for staging. to place a hold run `/deploy hold staging`.
diego: smoke now with header-heavy payload (~4.1kb): initial 5xx=1.4%, after small router tweak 0.35%. posting short logs to the release doc.
anu: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/shim/header-quick panels added: `router.backpressure_rate`, `kv_eviction_rate`, `api.header_size_p95`. will leave alerts active for 90m post-cutover.
harper: pin runtime -> v2.17.0 and placing the hold now. will keep console split FF disabled in staging.
harper: running `/deploy hold staging --reason "traffic-shim-header-safety"`
deploy-bot: hold placed by harper at 2961234675 (reason: traffic-shim-header-safety)
infra-bot: note: temporarily increased router tcp buffer and bumped connection window in staging for the slot. will revert after window unless extended.
diego: starting prewarm on shard-2. deploy-bot will report when finished.
deploy-bot: prewarm accepted; ETA ~13m.
anu: quick smoke after prewarm: 5xx 0.18%, kv_eviction_rate 0.007. looks within thresholds. posting short screenshot.
harper: lift criteria: 15m stable canary with 5xx <0.2% and kv_eviction_rate <0.008 and p50 <320ms. otherwise rollback.
diego: note: if `router.backpressure_rate` spikes >0.02 for 3m, we stop the ramp and revert routing immediately.
harper: agreed. i'll coordinate the unhold. keep posts short here for oncall.
deploy-bot: reminder: run `/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-2` to warm caches before ramp and `/deploy unhold staging` when you want to release.
olivia: thanks everyone. i'll watch the grafana panels and call the lift or rollback. concise updates only in this thread.
